How it works

A little more clarity, one step at a time.

You don’t need to have everything figured out before you begin. Start with one question.

Ask Aayu Hub

Step 01

Ask in your own words

Start with what’s on your mind. You don’t need medical terms to ask a question.

Step 02

Explore helpful information

Use Aayu Hub to learn about your concern and think about what to discuss with a professional.

Step 03

Choose your next step

Take your questions to a qualified healthcare professional when you need personal advice.

Aayu Hub is here for you

Feel more prepared to have the conversation.

Health questions can feel difficult to put into words. Aayu Hub gives you a calm place to organize what you’re wondering about and prepare to speak with a qualified professional.

Helpful information, with clear limits

Aayu Hub is for general information and preparation. It does not diagnose, replace a clinician, or provide emergency care.

If you may be having an emergency, contact your local emergency service now.
